title: Get an Instant Form lead or a direct message lead
content_data:
Use this endpoint to retrieve an Instant Form lead or a direct message lead. ## Request **Endpoint** https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/lead/get/ **Method** GET **Header** ```xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| |Access-Token {Required}|string|Authorized access token. For details, see [Authentication](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1738373164380162).| ``` **Parameters** ```xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| | lead_source {Required}| string | The source of the leads.

Enum values:
  • `INSTANT_FORM`: leads generated through an Instant Form.
  • `DIRECT_MESSAGE`: leads generated from direct messages of the associated Business Account.
| | advertiser_id {+Conditional} | string | Required when the leads are under an ad account.

Advertiser ID. | | library_id {+Conditional} | string | Required when the leads are under a form library of a Business Center.

ID of a form library.

To obtain the list of form libraries within a Business Center, use [/page/library/get/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1740029915327489). | | page_id {+Conditional} | string |
  • Required when `lead_source` is `INSTANT_FORM`.
  • Not supported when `lead_source` is `DIRECT_MESSAGE`.

The page ID of an Instant Form.

To obtain a list of Instant Forms, use [/page/get/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1820826387779586) and set `business_type` to `LEAD_GEN`. | ``` ### Example #### Get an Instant From lead ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --location --request GET 'https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/lead/get/?lead_source=INSTANT_FORM&advertiser_id={{advertiser_id}}&page_id={{page_id}}' \ --header 'Access-token: {{Access-token}}' (/code) ``` #### Get a direct message lead ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --location --request GET 'https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/lead/get/?lead_source=DIRECT_MESSAGE&advertiser_id={{advertiser_id}}' \ --header 'Access-token: {{Access-token}}' (/code) ``` ## Response ``` xtable |Field{30%}|Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| |code |number|Response code. For the complete list of response codes and descriptions, see [Appendix-Return Code](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097). | |message|string|Response message. For details, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097).| |request_id |string|The log ID of a request, which uniquely identifies the request. | |data |object|Returned data.| #| lead_data | object | The lead data.

Note: The data within this object depends on the questions that you have set in the Instant Form or the questions collected in the direct message lead. | #| meta_data | object | Metadata about the lead.| ##| lead_source | string | The source of the lead.

Enum values:

  • `INSTANT_FORM`: a lead generated through an Instant Form.
  • `DIRECT_MESSAGE`: a lead generated from a direct message of the associated Business Account.
| ##| lead_id | string | The lead ID. | ##| page_id | string | Returned only when `lead_source` is `INSTANT_FORM`.

The page ID of the Instant Form. | ##| campaign_id | string | The campaign ID.| ##| campaign_name | string | The campaign name. | ##| adgroup_id | string | The ad group ID.| ##| adgroup_name | string | The ad group name. | ##| ad_id | string | The ad ID.| ##| ad_name | string | The ad name. ##| create_time | dtring| The time when the lead was created, in the format of `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS` (UTC+0 time).

Example: `2025-01-01 00:00:01`. | ``` ### Example #### Get an Instant From lead ```xcodeblock (code Success-Response http) HTTPS/1.1 200 OK { "code": 0, "message": "OK", "request_id": "{{request_id}}", "data": { "lead_data": { "email": "{{email}}" }, "meta_data": { "ad_id": "{{ad_id}}", "ad_name": "{{ad_name}}", "adgroup_id": "{{adgroup_id}}", "adgroup_name": "{{adgroup_name}}", "campaign_id": "{{campaign_id}}", "campaign_name": "{{campaign_name}}", "create_time": "{{create_time}}", "lead_id": "{{lead_id}}", "lead_source": "INSTANT_FORM", "page_id": "{{page_id}}" } } } (/code) ``` #### Get a direct message lead ```xcodeblock (code Success-Response http) HTTPS/1.1 200 OK { "code": 0, "message": "OK", "request_id": "{{request_id}}", "data": { "lead_data": { "email": "{{email}}", "name": "{{name}}", "phone_number": "{{phone_number}}", "tiktok": "{{tiktok}}" }, "meta_data": { "ad_id": "{{ad_id}}", "ad_name": "{{ad_name}}", "adgroup_id": "{{adgroup_id}}", "adgroup_name": "{{adgroup_name}}", "campaign_id": "{{campaign_id}}", "campaign_name": "{{campaign_name}}", "create_time": "{{create_time}}", "lead_id": "{{lead_id}}", "lead_source": "DIRECT_MESSAGE", "page_id": "{{page_id}}" } } } (/code) ```
